predictions.articleTitle: Deportivo Cali vs Millonarios Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Palmaseca Wall vs Ruiz Void
predictions.coreRecommendation: Deportivo Cali's undefeated Palmaseca regular-season defense and full-strength spine hold the primary edge against a Millonarios side missing injured Daniel Ruiz, while high H2H and season draw frequency supports retaining Home Win / Draw alongside Under 2.5 and BTTS No.

Under 2.5 total goals supported by Cali's 47.4% clean-sheet rate, Millonarios' 73.3% big-chance waste rate, and Quadrangular Matchday 1 caution (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Undefeated Palmaseca defense faces Ruiz-less Millonarios in tight opener.

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 Deportivo Cali home victory driven by defensive solidity and a 1:1 draw reflecting three straight H2H stalemates, as Millonarios' returning suspension duo makes a single Home Win slightly riskier.

over_under.comment: Both clubs averaged roughly 2.1–2.3 total goals per regular-season match, while Cali's 47.4% clean-sheet rate and Millonarios' Daniel Ruiz absence suppress scoring ceiling.

btts.comment: Deportivo Cali conceded just 12 goals in 19 regular-season games and restore Pedro Gallese against a Millonarios attack missing Daniel Ruiz with a 73.3% big-chance waste rate.

score.comment: Balances Cali's home shutout efficiency against Millonarios' three-match H2H draw run and Leonardo Castro's return.

goals.comment: Bridged Poisson expectancy (~2.10 goals) peaks at 2 goals (27%) closely followed by 1 goal (26%).

bqc.comment: High-foul officiating and Matchday 1 caution point to a level half-time before either a late Cali breakthrough or a full-time stalemate.
